response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and some low-latency systems work, plus strong community teaching/mentoring signals. However, the role's hard minimum of 8 years of C++ programming is not met — the resume shows roughly 6 months of C/C++ work at National Instruments and a C++ bachelor thesis project. Most recent experience is TypeScript/Node.js product and web work rather than large-scale compute/infrastructure platforms, and there is no evidence of a formal technical leadership role owning platform strategy, cloud architecture at production scale, or cross-team project management. The nearest adjacent experience (high-throughput D services at Sociomantic, Kubernetes-deployable GIS platform) is real but too limited in scale and duration to offset the core gaps.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across backend, embedded, and high-throughput services
Demonstrated mentoring: workshops, courses, dojos, open-source tooling ownership
Founder of an open-source platform, showing ownership of ambiguous long-running projects
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months professionally)
No cloud compute platform or large-scale infrastructure architecture ownership
No formal technical lead role leading teams, priorities, and deliverables

key_factors.factor: Large-scale infrastructure / cloud compute platform experience
